_about: Peru world source data for the Sheppard_Atahualpa_ambush clip (Dwarkesh map style). Built 2026-10-02 by the director session. lon/lat WGS84.

realm_1532.source: Union of the expansion phases (Pachacuti, Tupac Inca x2, Huayna Capac) of QQuantum, 'Inca Expansion.svg' (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0; the standard Wikipedia map of Tawantinsuyu at its 1525-1532 extent), georeferenced to Natural Earth by coastline ICP (degree-3 polynomial; west-coast residual median 1.6 km, p95 5 km), clipped to Natural Earth 10m land; one inland slit between two phases (lon -77.4..-77.9, lat -2.8..-3.1) removed; three pin-holes and four islets dropped. Extent lon -81.28..-63.25, lat +2.32..-35.74 (Ancasmayo/Pasto to the Maule).

lakes.source: Natural Earth 10m lakes (public domain), outer rings; Poopo existed in 1532

sites._source: SP/FACTS.md section 5 (route table: OSM / esWP coordinates of the modern places) and section 2 (OSM: the plaza centroid, the Banos del Inca hot-spring complex). Added by builder A, 2026-10-02.

tumbes.note: Inca Tumbes = the Cabeza de Vaca site, Corrales [esWP]; the landing, c. late April 1532

poechos.note: camp at 'Puechio' on the Chira, 24 May [Xer p.20; Mk]

sanMiguel.note: San Miguel founded at Tangarara, Chira valley, mid-1532 [esWP-Piura]

piuraFort.note: Piura valley, a chief's fortress, 27 Sep - 7 Oct, the muster [Xer p.25; Tru p.49] (Piura la Vieja, tentative)

pabor.note: Pabor, a walled court, 7 Oct [Xer p.26] (Pabur, a match by name)

illimo.note: the Motupe and Leche valleys, c. 25-27 Oct [Mk p.33n] (Illimo as the example given)

nanchoc.note: the modern Qhapaq Nan route from Zana [And]

cajamarca.note: Cajamarca, Plaza de Armas (centroid) [OSM]; arrival Fri 15 Nov [Xer p.44]

banosDelInca.note: Banos del Inca, the hot-spring complex [OSM]: Atahualpa's camp (Pultumarca) [PPz pp.174-175; Hem/wp; esWP-Cap]

route_pizarro_1532._source: SP/FACTS.md section 5: Xerez's stops (Markham's chronology), modern identifications from OSM / esWP; the climb from Zana by the modern Qhapaq Nan route (Nanchoc, Niepos, Llapa) [And]. Soto's detour to Caxas / Huancabamba is not the main column's route. Copiz and the Cinto crossing have no coordinates and are not waypoints.

local_plan._source: SP/FACTS.md sections 2-3. The plaza is a SCHEMATIC from the texts (no eyewitness measured it; no published plan of 1532).
